# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def check_students(students):
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students given")
    for item in students:
        if not item.email:
            name = item.display_name
            raise ProjectError(f"no email for {name}")


def format_row(item, namewide, sectwide):
    return "  ".join([
        item.display_name.ljust(namewide),
        item.section.ljust(sectwide),
        item.email
    ])


def format_contacts(students):
    """Rows of name, section and email, sorted by name."""
    check_students(students)
    rows = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    namewide = max(len(item.display_name) for item in rows)
    sectwide = max(len(item.section) for item in rows)
    return [format_row(item, namewide, sectwide) for item in rows]
